# Good Risk Selection Must Trump Growth in Casualty


-


11/02/26


The key to building a profitable portfolio is not to view US casualty as one single market – or make decisions using broad market averages, says Christopher Larson, Global Head of Casualty Underwriting at SiriusPoint.


In the day one edition of Intelligent Insurer at the American Property Casualty Insurance Association (APCIA) Annual Meeting, Chris covers the downward pressure on US casualty pricing, the growing importance of risk selection, and the limits of backward looking industry pricing.


“We are seeing particular pressure in primary general liability and lead umbrella, where rate momentum has moderated while the underlying loss environment has not. That means you must respond quickly when the economics change.”


[Click here](https://ss-usa.s3.amazonaws.com/c/308478362/media/18836ae75d283ad6b04594538957301/Day%201_APCIAT_2026_Emag.pdf) to read the full interview on page 18 in the Intelligent Insurer’s APCIA day one edition.
